public.text: Supply-chain forecasting and anomaly detection require reliable historic demand, inventory, product, facility, and logistics data, which may be weak in lower-resource settings.
public.suggestedRevision: State the minimum data-quality and coverage requirements and identify simpler statistical or rules-based alternatives where advanced models are not justified.
